title: Reopen nonconformance
purpose: Reopen a closed issue while preserving its earlier closure and evidence.
summary: Reopen a closed nonconformance. It returns to Investigating, and the earlier closure stays in the timeline.

tasks.title: Add information without reopening
steps: Go back to the record and select [[Add note or evidence]]. A closed issue can take notes.

good_to_know: Reopening clears the current verification, closure note, closer and close time. The earlier closure stays in the timeline.
Root cause, disposition, corrective action, owner, due date and links are kept.
If the due date has passed, the reopened issue is past due again.

sections.title: Who can change this record
paragraphs: Any lab staff member can open a nonconformance, read it and add notes/evidence, including after closure. Only its assigned owner or an admin, reviewer, approver or project manager role can edit details or drive workflow. Opening a record does not by itself give the opener management rights. Staff selectors list active non-client accounts, ordered by username, with full name and username when available.

items.label: Current issue
items.description: Page shows number, title and current Closed status. Available only when Closed; another status redirects with an unavailable-step message.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required nonblank reason retained in the timeline.

items.label: Reopen
items.description: Returns to Investigating; clears current verification, closure note, closing actor and close time. Cause, disposition, corrective action, owner, due date and links remain. Earlier closure text and evidence remain in timeline changes and prior entries. A retained past due date makes the reopened issue Past due again.

sections.title: Saving and errors
paragraphs: An asterisk marks required fields. Cancel returns to the parent record or list without saving. Success opens the saved record with a confirmation. Validation errors appear above the form and beside affected fields; correct them and submit again. Text input remains after validation errors; select an evidence file again if necessary. Dates use year-month-day; date and time fields use the deployment time zone.

sections.title: Concurrent changes and history
paragraphs: Saving locks and rechecks the revision you opened. If another user changed the record, reload it, review the latest values and enter your change again. Failed validation writes no partial change. Successful changes and attributed audit events commit together.

sections.title: Workflow and limits
paragraphs: The fixed flow is Open, Investigating, Corrective action, Verification, Closed. Steps cannot be skipped. Verification can return to Corrective action; Closed can reopen to Investigating, each with a reason. Severity and disposition are recorded choices; the system does not infer them. A linked issue or a disposition such as Hold or Qualify does not automatically hold a batch, qualify a result, retire equipment, alter stock or block report release. Apply any separate operational controls explicitly. There is no required independent verifier rule in this workflow; the owner or lead can verify and close.

sections.title: Form dialog controls
paragraphs: With enhancement enabled, the form opens in a dialog, including when its URL is opened directly. Without enhancement it remains a normal page. While loading or saving, controls are disabled to avoid duplicate submissions; focus moves to the first invalid field or first editable field when ready. Saving successfully navigates to the resulting record.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: Expand the dialog to full screen or restore its normal size. Small screens use a full-screen layout.

items.label: Cancel / Close form / Escape
items.description: Close an unchanged form. When opened over another page, return focus to its opening control; when opened directly, return to the Cancel destination. Clicking outside the dialog does not close it.

items.label: Keep editing / Discard changes
items.description: After an input change, attempting to leave asks Discard your unsaved changes? Keep editing retains the form; Discard changes closes or follows the requested destination without saving. Escape during that prompt keeps editing.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Shown after a failed initial load. Retry loading the form. Save/connection errors keep the current input and show an error so you can retry the submission. Validation errors replace the form with its submitted values and field messages; files may need selecting again.
